name: hostelfix
description: Hostel complaint and maintenance management system

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && node -e "import('fs').then(fs => fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}))"
